playbooks.why: ad/GOAD-Light has no entry of its own in the fork's top-level playbooks.yml, so it runs the 16-invocation `default:` chain. Nothing to carry.

kept: data/inventory group layout and host-key membership, verbatim — including the parent/child split ([parent_dc] dc01, [child_dc] dc02) that ad-child_domain.yml keys on
providers/proxmox/inventory host -> {{ip_range}}.N -> dict_key mapping, octets unchanged (dc01 .10, dc02 .11, srv02 .22)
the dns_domain wiring: dc02 resolves through dc01, srv02 resolves through dc02 — a child DC must resolve the parent forest before it can be promoted
data/config.json hosts: hostname / type / domain / path / local_admin_password / use_laps (values replaced with generic placeholders)
data/config.json domains: dc / netbios_name / domain_password / laps_path / trust (values replaced with generic placeholders)
the password invariant: a member host carries its OWN domain's domain_password as local_admin_password
stripped: the entire reskin. ad/GOAD-Light in the fork is a themed rebrand — a company domain, site-prefixed hostnames, a named staff roster, and scripts/ hardcoded to those names. None of it survives: domains, hostnames, NetBIOS names and passwords are generic placeholders.
domains[*].groups — emptied to {} (upstream carries the universal/global/domainlocal scope buckets; the composer must re-emit all three, roles/ad indexes ad_groups.global with no default)

domains[*].acls — emptied to {}. This is the one that matters most: the parent domain upstream carries a 12-edge ACL ladder, and letting it survive a re-sync would hand every tier-M client the identical attack path.
domains[*].gmsa — emptied to {} (absent on this tier upstream; carried as an empty object so every tier has one shape)
hosts[*].scripts — emptied to []; upstream dc02 listed seven .ps1 files from the lab's scripts/ directory
hosts[*].local_groups — emptied to {}; every upstream entry named a domain user or group, i.e. payload

hosts.srv02.mssql — dropped entirely (sa_password, service account, sysadmins, EXECUTE AS mappings). srv02 is still in [mssql], so a chassis fed straight to goad-preflight is rejected with GOAD_PF_MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD_MISSING — which is the point.
files/ — dropped entirely (ESC1 template, IIS webroot with the roslyn compiler, SYSVOL bait scripts, share bait)
scripts/ — dropped entirely; every file was hardcoded to the reskin's identifiers
README.md — dropped; it still described the ORIGINAL lab's hosts, not the reskin's, and provenance now lives in this file
data/inventory_disable_vagrant — dropped; only data/inventory is a chassis input
providers/{aws,azure,ludus,virtualbox,vmware,vmware_esxi} and every *.tf — dropped; the lane provider is proxmox
composer_must_fill: domains[*].users and domains[*].groups — goad-preflight REQUIRED_DOMAIN_KEYS lists both; ansible/ad-data.yml reads lab.domains[d].users and .groups with NO `| default(...)`
domains[*].organisation_units if any users[*].path or groups[*][*].path names an OU
hosts.srv02.mssql.sa_password — servers.yml:31 is the only line in that play without a `| default(...)`
the placeholder identifiers below — every one is deliberately implausible so a leak is unmistakable rather than believable

placeholders.why: .invalid is the RFC 2606 reserved TLD, so a chassis domain that survives into a generated lab cannot be mistaken for a client's. The child FQDN must stay a strict suffix extension of the parent: ad-child_domain.yml derives parent_domain by dropping the first label and then reads lab.domains[parent].domain_password with no default.

note: A CHASSIS IS DELIBERATELY NOT DEPLOYABLE. It is compile-time INPUT read on the orchestrator, not a lab: the compiler repopulates it and emits ad/CIAB-<hash>/, which is pushed to the controller separately. The controller never reads a chassis. Deploying one as-is dies in ad-data.yml, which dereferences lab.domains[d].users and .groups with no default — a domain whose groups are empty kills that play. That is correct and expected. Re-syncing when upstream moves is a mechanical diff: point at the same paths under the goad_ref above, re-apply the `stripped` list, and re-run front-end/test/ciab-chassis.test.js.
